note: Part 2 of the catalogue: Fabric, OneLake, Synapse, Databricks (DBU only), Power BI Embedded and Stream Analytics.

types.label: Microsoft Fabric capacity
types.note: F SKUs: capacity units (CU) per hour, pay-as-you-go or a 1-year reservation. Every Fabric capacity-usage meter carries the same CU-hour rate; the Power BI one is the reference. OneLake storage is a separate type. The Retail API's 3-year reservation row is exactly three times the 1-year row, so it is not offered. Power BI Pro licences for viewers below F64 are separate (Licences).

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Microsoft Fabric' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: OneLake storage
types.note: Data stored in OneLake per GB a month. Transactions, BCDR storage and the cache are not included.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Microsoft Fabric' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: Synapse dedicated SQL pool
types.note: Compute by DWU level (cDWU), per hour, pay-as-you-go or reserved. Every level is the DW100c price times its size. Storage and snapshots are separate. Spark pools, serverless SQL (separate type) and pipelines are not included.

inputs.label: Pools
inputs.help: Dedicated SQL pools of this size, billed per hour while running.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Azure Synapse Analytics' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: Synapse serverless SQL pool
types.note: Per TB of data processed. Storage is billed separately.

inputs.label: Data processed
inputs.help: Data processed by queries a month.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Azure Synapse Analytics' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: Databricks (DBU only)
types.note: Databricks units (DBU) only. The virtual machines the cluster runs on are billed separately: add them as VM resources. Serverless SKUs include the compute. Pre-purchase plans, model serving beyond the DBU rate and the compliance add-ons are not included.

inputs.label: DBU consumed
inputs.help: DBUs consumed a month (DBU rate per node-hour x node-hours).

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Azure Databricks' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

dbu.meterName: ^Premium Core Compute Delta Live Tables DBU$
^Premium Pro Compute Delta Live Tables DBU$
^Premium Advanced Compute Delta Live Tables DBU$

types.label: Power BI Embedded (A SKUs)
types.note: Embedded capacity nodes per hour. Fabric F SKUs are the successor and a separate type.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Power BI Embedded' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: Stream Analytics
types.note: Standard streaming units per hour. The V2 SKUs (tiered by hours used) and dedicated clusters are not included.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Stream Analytics' and armRegionName eq '{region}'
